title: Encarregado de Manutenção - Estamparia
description:
O Encarregado de Manutenção - Estamparia será responsável por liderar as atividades de manutenção para alcançar altos índices de desempenho de sua equipe e equipamentos.

As principais atividades serão:

• Liderar e aprovar as atividades de Manutenção Preventiva, Corretiva e Inspeção nos equipamentos pelo sistema SAP;

• Acompanhar o desenvolvimento técnico dos colaboradores e identificar treinamentos para suprir as deficiências do departamento;

• Construir e desenvolver equipes e participar da seleção e recrutamento de colaboradores;

• Participar efetivamente nos resultados da empresa e índices do departamento, garantido o cumprimento dos KPIs da área e preenchimento das APRs e ASTs (procedimentos de segurança);

• Usar ferramentas de qualidade para análise de causa raiz e contra-medidas, e trabalhar na otimização de mão de obra e identificação dos processos que agregam valor ao cliente;

• Controlar a organização da oficina, escritório e estoque de peças sobressalentes;

• Garantir a conservação, limpeza e manutenção de aparelhos, guarda de ferramentas e equipamentos e monitorar as condições de Segurança e o uso de EPI em campo dos colaboradores;

• Responder pelas tarefas administrativas do departamento, tais como: Agendamento de Férias, Relatórios, Interface com outros Departamentos e Preparar relatórios de manutenção;

• Participar efetivamente nas atividades relacionadas a Gestão das Normas ISO 9001, 14001 e ISO 45001;

• Contribuir efetivamente no controle de orçamento e acompanhar e controlar a execução dos contratos de manutenção terceirizada.

Se interessou? Os requisitos para a vaga são:

• Curso Técnico completo em Elétrica, Eletromecânica, Mecânica ou correlatos;

• Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia (Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção, etc) ou cursos correlatos;

• Inglês intermediário;

• Experiência em liderança de equipes;

• Conhecimento em atividades de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e a inspeção de equipamentos e robôs.

Será um diferencial:

• Pós graduação;

• Inglês Avançado;

• Experiência prévia com a área de Estamparia.

title: Key Account Manager (AME)
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced B2B Key Account Manager with a background in the travel industry, to join our team. As a Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with our key clients, ensuring their needs are met, and driving business growth.

About the Role - Main Responsibilities:

  • In Charge of Existing Clients (API Wholesale Online - API Retail Offline - WebShopping Account) Within the assigned territory.
  • Develop and implement strategic account plans to achieve sales targets, foster account growth, and identify new business opportunities.
  • Acquisition of new key accounts within the assigned territory.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with clients to assess their needs, address concerns, and provide solutions that meet their objectives.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts to maximize revenue generation.
  • Prepare and present reports on account performance, sales forecasts, and market insights.
  • Collaborate with product development teams to provide feedback and insights from clients, contributing to the development of new products/services.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities to proactively identify potential threats and opportunities.

Qualifications - Position Requirements:

  • Strong influencing and negotiation skills, thriving in the creation and maintenance of successful long-term commercial relationships with clients and other stakeholders.
  • Experienced with proven ability to deliver results in an autonomous working environment.
  • Solid experience and commercial knowledge of the travel & hospitality industries.
  • Commercially good knowledge of business for B2B, as well as new business segments and models.
  • Project management skills.
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese as working languages is required. Fluency in Spanish is a plus.

title: iOS Developer (Objective C) (Req. English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is an innovative technology company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge mobile solutions in a remote, collaborative environment. Our projects focus on developing high-performance iOS applications that drive user engagement and business growth, utilizing advanced technologies and modern development practices.
Position Overview We are seeking a skilled iOS Developer to join our team. You'll build and maintain scalable mobile applications using modern iOS development technologies, with a strong emphasis on test-driven development and API integration.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop native iOS applications using Objective-C and modern iOS frameworks
  • Design and implement robust mobile architectures following Apple's best practices
  • Practice test-driven development for reliable and maintainable code
  • Integrate with RESTful APIs and backend services
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and participate in code reviews
  • Optimize application performance and ensure smooth user experiences
Required Technical Skills iOS Development
  • Objective-C (required) and Swift (preferred)
  • Xcode and iOS SDK
  • UIKit and Auto Layout
  • Human Interface Guidelines and iOS design patterns
  • Responsive layouts and multi-device support (iPhone, iPad)
Architecture & Patterns
  • MVC, MVVM, or VIPER architecture
  • Dependency injection patterns
  • Delegation and protocol-oriented programming
  • Grand Central Dispatch (GCD) and concurrency
  • Memory management (ARC, retain cycles)
Backend Integration
  • RESTful API consumption (URLSession, Alamofire)
  • JSON parsing and data serialization (Codable, NSJSONSerialization)
  • Authentication and authorization implementation
  • GraphQL (nice to have)
Testing & DevOps
  • Test-driven development methodology
  • Testing frameworks: XCTest, XCUITest, OCMock, Quick/Nimble
  • Unit, integration, and UI testing
  • CI/CD pipeline setup (GitHub Actions, Fastlane, Xcode Cloud)
  • Version control with Git
Data & Storage
  • Core Data for local persistence
  • UserDefaults and Keychain for secure storage
  • Local caching strategies
  • CloudKit or Firebase integration
Nice to Have
  • React Native experience for cross-platform development
  • Swift knowledge
  • SwiftUI for modern declarative UI development
  • Firebase services (Analytics, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging)
  • In-app purchases and subscription management (StoreKit)
  • App Store publishing and TestFlight distribution
  • Push notifications (APNs, User Notifications framework)
  • Universal Links and deep linking
  • Core Animation and advanced UI effects
  • Combine framework for reactive programming
  • Accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type)
Preferred Qualifications
  • 3+ years of professional iOS development experience
  • Published apps on the App Store
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Understanding of mobile app security best practices
  • Experience with Apple's App Review Guidelines
  • Knowledge of App Store Optimization (ASO)

title: Coordenador(a)/Supervisor(a) de Lojas
description:
Com 31 anos de história, a Any Any transforma os momentos simples do dia a dia em experiências cheias de leveza, conforto e estilo. Criamos pijamas e peças homewear com qualidade e design alinhado às tendências, para que você aproveite o melhor da vida com quem ama. Estamos presentes em 50 lojas próprias e 300 pontos de venda em todo o Brasil.

Procuramos um(a) COORDENADOR(A)/SUPERVISOR(A) DE LOJAS PRÓPRIAS (PJ) para somar ao nosso time e contribuir com a construção de uma marca que valoriza o conforto e a transparência.

A Coordenadora/Supervisora Comercial de Lojas será responsável por liderar e supervisionar o desempenho das lojas sob sua gestão, garantindo o alcance de metas comerciais, excelência no atendimento e alinhamento com os valores e diretrizes da empresa. A profissional atuará também fazendo a gestão de supervisoras.

Principais Atividades:

  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (vendas, ticket médio, taxa de conversão, entre outros).
  • Desenvolver estratégias para atingir e superar as metas de vendas e rentabilidade.
  • Monitorar o estoque e garantir a reposição adequada dos produtos nas lojas.
  • Supervisionar gerentes e equipes de vendas nas unidades sob sua gestão.
  • Realizar treinamentos e feedbacks para garantir o desenvolvimento contínuo das equipes.
  • Assegurar a excelência no atendimento ao cliente, alinhada com os padrões da empresa.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes e políticas da marca em todas as lojas.
  • Elaborar relatórios de performance e sugerir ações de melhorias com base nos resultados.
  • Acompanhar ações promocionais, campanhas de marketing e datas sazonais.
  • Propor iniciativas para aumentar a rentabilidade e fidelização dos clientes.

Principais Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada no segmento de varejo de moda .
  • Experiência em gestão de múltiplas lojas e grandes equipes.
  • Conhecimento de KPIs de varejo e ferramentas de análise de resultados.
  • Habilidade com ferramentas de controle (Excel e sistemas de vendas).
  • Vivência em estratégias de visual merchandising e processos de loja.
  • Liderança e capacidade de gestão de pessoas.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Visão estratégica e habilidade para resolução de problemas.
  • Perfil dinâmico, pró-ativo e com alta capacidade de organização.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens entre as lojas sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Flexibilidade de horários, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.

Modelo de contrato:

  • PJ

Benefícios :

  • 30 dias de descanso após aniversário de contrato;
  • Atualização anual do contrato de acordo com o IPCA acumulado dos últimos 12 meses;
  • 20% de desconto nos produtos da marca.

Adicionais:

  • Necessário possuir veículo próprio - temos a tag "sem parar" para estacionamento e pedágio.
  • Comissão e premiação.

Modelo de trabalho : 100% presencial, atuando nas lojas.

Na Any Any, procuramos pessoas que gostam do varejo e se sentem motivadas por novos desafios. Se isso representa quem você é, queremos te conhecer!

title: Designer gráfico
description:
Quem somos

A Granistone é referência global na produção de rochas ornamentais brasileiras, combinando tradição, inovação e sustentabilidade. Fundada em 1989, somos uma empresa cearense com presença internacional, que atua em toda a cadeia produtiva — da extração à entrega de materiais exclusivos para projetos de alto padrão. Nosso compromisso vai além da excelência: valorizamos a ética, a responsabilidade ambiental e relações duradouras. Aqui, você fará parte de um time apaixonado pelo que faz, com espaço para crescer, inovar e transformar.

Nossos Valores:

Temos valores cristãos, bons costumes e ética.

Agimos com verdade, honestidade e integridade;

Respeitamos o próximo;

Liberalismo econômico;

Atitude, Garra e Pro atividade;

Trabalhamos com união e confiabilidade

Designer Gráfico

Local: Aldeota

Modalidade: Presencial

Horário: 08:00 às 17:30 de segunda a quinta-feira

08:0 às 17:00 sexta-feira

Salário: R$ 5.170,61

  • Ensino superior concluído em Marketing, Designer ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência estética de luxo, arquitetura ou produtos premium.
  • Extremamente detalhista, criativo e apaixonado por estética, composição e textura.
  • Rigor técnico e capacidade de execução impecável.
  • Domínio de Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign e softwares de edição de vídeo (Premiere, CapCut, Final Cut ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade em tratamento de imagem e manipulação de fotos.
  • Experiência com materiais impressos premium e conhecimento de acabamento gráfico.
  • Conhecimento de formatos verticais, vídeos curtos e uso avançado de IA para criação e tratamento de imagens.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa, comunicativa e proativa, sempre buscando soluções criativas e inovadoras.

Principais Atividades:

  • Criar peças gráficas para campanhas digitais e impressas, incluindo banners, posts para redes sociais, catálogos, folders, apresentações, materiais institucionais e comerciais.
  • Desenvolver identidades visuais para coleções, campanhas e projetos especiais, garantindo aplicação consistente em todos os pontos de contato.

  • Preparar arquivos para impressão, garantindo padrões de qualidade e acabamento gráfico (papel, verniz, laminação, cartonagem).
  • Manter o arquivo de design organizado e acessível para a equipe.
  • Criar moodboards, paletas, diretrizes visuais e materiais de apoio ao time de vendas e marketing.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas (marketing, vendas e desenvolvimento) e apoiar o Social Media na criação de artes estáticas, carrosséis e outros materiais visuais.
  • Pesquisar tendências de design e comportamento digital, trazendo referências e inovações visuais para a empresa.
  • Participar de reuniões, propor melhorias nos processos de criação e otimizar rotinas operacionais do setor.
  • Prestar orientações sobre design para colaboradores e clientes quando necessário, garantindo a consistência e qualidade visual da marca.

Benefícios:

  • Cartão alimentação/refeição (R$ 660,00);
  • Plano de Saúde 50%;
  • Plano odontológico 50%;
  • 3% Produtividade;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Total Pass;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Parcerias Educacionais;
  • Plano de Cargos e Carreiras.

title: Plant Human Resources Manager
description:
We are looking for a HR Plant Manager to join our team in our plant in Brazil (Sete Lagoas/MG) . The chosen candidate will be responsible to execute HR strategy, deal with recruitment, training, and development processes, managing local trends and needs building the best team in line with budget, guidelines and local labor laws and regulations. The role creates a diverse and inclusive ecosystem by leveraging talent management, succession planning and accurate total rewards for the assigned Plant, acting in full alignment with the leader above as well as the coherent with the organization model and HR policy and guidelines. HR Manager ensures accurate execution of cost analysis in line with guidance and leads HR administration and payroll processes being a unique point of contact for labor industrial relations and disputes at the plant level.

Activities

  • Defines, develops, and implements HR programs and plans on annual basis for the assigned sites in alignment HR Strategy defined by CHRO and in alignment with the HR Corporate directives, industrial plan, and budget.
  • Manages staff and recruiting processes, implements compensation and reward strategy, and ensures consistency with the organizational model, in full collaboration with the Regional HR, HR Center of Expertise and CHRO.
  • Analyses the country-specific trends on a regular basis, sharing with regional/corporate actionable inputs and insights and contributing to the definition of sustainable and competitive actions and strategic targets.
  • Ensures the execution of corporate global and local guidelines and procedures, implements promptly and effectively corrective and preventive actions to ensure full alignment and compliance with local law.
  • Executes performance management, training, and development program defined by HR Center of Expertise and provides them prompt and accurate feedback to ensure the effective and sustainable roll-out for the sites assigned.
  • Recruits, develops and retains resources, cultivates high potential talents, enables succession plans.
  • Plans how to cover replaces/covers vacant local positions, implements job enlargement, rotation, and enrichment in line with legal requirements, procedures, budget, business and organization model, and Company guidelines.
  • Creates an inclusive environment and adopts and open-door, encourages employees to speak up as key of success.
  • Provides guidance on HR processes, solves issues in line with legal, HR& Organization and business strategy.
  • Ensures the employee relationship management respects the relevant legal and Labour contract requirements, development, compensation, and benefit guidelines practices, in adherence with the company governances.
  • Provides the plant with HR services, including administration, payroll, and industrial relations, collaborating with the HR team and implementing tools and fair labor practices per labor law.
  • Elaborates and monitors the budget, supervising the related processes at the local level aimed at ensuring cost-effectiveness and company sustainable business growth.
  • Oversees and keeps HR costs effectiveness under control promptly identifying opportunities to exploit, managing risk appropriately, and setting up a contingency plan to foster HR strategy deployment.
  • Manages, coaches, and develops assigned staff, ensuring effective talent management and career path
  • Interacts regularly and effectively communicates and networks with key internal and external stakeholders, to deliver assigned targets as well as to ensure an effective alignment of company objectives and strategic goals.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • 5 years proven experience gained in Human Resources management and +2 years as HR Plant Manager, within international companies
  • Proficiency in English (speaking and writing in English is 40% of daily routine)
  • Graduate in Human Resources, Business Administration, Law or Psychology
  • Knowledge of Talent Management and succession planning techniques
  • Knowledge of Compensation and Total Reward techniques, methodologies, tools
  • Knowledge of HR Management, employment-related laws, trade unions organising and management
  • Knowledge of human resources information systems (HRIS)
  • Change Management
  • Knowledge of Product and Production: process, features techniques
  • Data Analysis and performances metrics: methodologies, techniques, tools and applications
  • Budget management and cost control knowledge
  • Live in Sete Lagoas (work in presence is mandatory)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced knowledge in Excel and Power BI
  • Experience with WCM
  • Experience with ISO standards

About Us

We are a dynamic organization with great customers and a culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver amazing results. We are also growing and looking to hire talented and passionate individuals to join our team!

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Operações
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Formulation Scientist
description:
Position Summary

The role will provide technical support for local laboratory work, with a primary focus on formulation development to support customer projects, the promotion of Vantage™ products, and customer events. Responsibilities include preparing reports and applying Vantage™ raw materials in formulations, with the goal of providing practical tools for the sales force and supporting strategic customers in the region.

The Research Scientist – Formulation & Application will be a science-driven project leader, responsible for planning, managing, supporting, and executing formulation and product development projects in LATAM, with a special emphasis on Brazil. This role will work closely with global R&D and Marketing teams, ideating, identifying, and developing new products for market launch, contributing to the growth of Vantage Personal Care in LATAM and globally.

Key responsibilities include developing formulations for major customers and evaluating their performance to demonstrate the benefits of our technologies, developing new personal care applications, and creating market-relevant concepts that promote Vantage™ technologies through marketing campaigns, customer events, trade shows, and industry activities. In addition, this role will design and perform (or coordinate) the necessary

performance tests to demonstrate and reinforce the value proposition of Vantage™ technologies.

Position Scope

The position will be located in Brasil.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Development of new formulations to highlight ingredients from Vantage portfolio and their added values in formulation (skin care, hair care, makeup, and toiletries applications) according to internal and external needs, such as Marketing campaigns, trade shows, customers events and needs etc.

· Support in tests for performance studies and sensorial tests for costumer projects.

· Contribute to new product development projects to improve VPC product portfolio, including discovering new products based on market trends and customers feedback, assessing technical feasibility, developing the new product, designing and conducting needed performance tests to improve the product design, and finalizing product specs, etc.

· Monitor stability testing of formulations: organoleptic and physicochemical analyses.

· Qualification of Vantage ingredients and issue the report with the results.

· Ensure the efficient operation of the laboratory (respect for SOPs, raw materials and packaging inventory management…).

· Use knowledge of routine laboratory safety procedures, SDS’s and interpretations of hazards/toxicity data to perform all laboratory work in accordance with the written safety manual and site safety policies.

· Be a steward for safety and continually drive awareness to ensure a safe work environment for all employees.

· Understand formulation procedures and technologies and incorporate this understanding into applications that add value to customer products.

· Maintain accurate records of all laboratory work and research in accordance with generally accepted laboratory principles.

· Manage the calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment.

Note: The duties listed above are not all inclusive and may be subject to periodic updating or revision.

Education & Experience:

Education: Bachelor of Chemistry, Pharmacobiology, Cosmetics Technology, Pharmacy or related areas, linked to sciences (Chemistry).

Experience: between 5 to 8 years’ working experience in the cosmetics and chemical industry.

Knowledge, Skills, & Talents

· Spanish and English speaker.

· Ability to apply logical and scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Grupo Boticario - Bioguardian
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

No Grupo Boticário, a busca por inovação sustentável e ciência aplicada à beleza se traduz em iniciativas que integram tecnologia, pesquisa e propósito. Nesse contexto, o projeto prevê o desenvolvimento e a validação de metodologias baseadas em técnicas avançadas de biologia molecular, com o objetivo de aprimorar a precisão e a confiabilidade das análises microbiológicas relacionadas à qualidade e à segurança de produtos e processos.

O profissional selecionado também poderá atuar em estudos voltados para a compreensão de aspectos biológicos relevantes ao cuidado da pele, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções mais eficazes e alinhadas às necessidades dos consumidores. Trata-se de uma oportunidade estratégica, inserida em um ambiente que valoriza inovação, rigor científico e excelência em beleza e bem-estar.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo Doutorado em Química, Farmácia, Biologia, Biotecnologia, Bioquímica e áreas correlatas

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Idioma: Inglês intermediário

Projeto: Bioguardian

Principais Atividades:

  • Apoiar nas rotinas de microbiologia: preparo de meios, cultivo e manutenção de microrganismos.
  • Realizar cultivo celular (linhagens 2D e 3D), incluindo preparo de meios, passagens e criopreservação.
  • Participar da implementação e manutenção de modelos 3D e sistemas organ-on-a-chip.
  • Executar técnicas básicas de biologia molecular (extração de DNA/RNA, PCR, ELISA).
  • Apoiar em procedimentos histológicos (fixação, corte, coloração e análise de lâminas).
  • Organizar e registrar dados experimentais, contribuindo na elaboração de relatórios técnicos.
  • Participar da discussão e apresentação de resultados em reuniões de grupo.
  • Auxiliar na redação de artigos científicos e preparação de pôsteres e apresentações.
  • Colaborar na organização e manutenção do laboratório e de materiais de uso comum.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas, analisar dados e interpretar resultados para apoiar a tomada de decisões;
  • Boa habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Aptidão para atuação colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Proatividade na identificação e resolução de problemas;
  • Flexibilidade para lidar com mudanças nas diretrizes, regulamentações e necessidades do projeto;
  • Mentalidade orientada para resultados, com foco em cumprimento de prazos e avanços consistentes;

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Técnicas de Biologia Molecular, preferencialmente RT-qPCR e PCR Digital
  • Conhecimentos em análises microbiológicas;
  • Experiência com cultivo celular.

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Híbrido (3 a 5x por semana presencial)

Soft Skills : Trabalho em Equipe, Auto Gestão, Pensamento crítico, Criatividade e Ética e responsabilidade, Criatividade.

title: Complex Investigations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand

$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses

Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.

AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.

Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)

  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)

Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)

  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency

Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback

Why Top Editors Choose Us:

Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.

Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.

See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Chief Technology Officer - CTO
description:
Purpose of the Position

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.

More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.
  • Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.
  • Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.
  • Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.
  • Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.
  • Influence and earn autonomy: Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.
  • Drive engagement and culture: Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.
  • Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders: Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.
  • Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.
  • Transformation delivery: Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.g., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).
  • Systems architecture expertise : Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (.NET Framework, .NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).
  • Operational excellence: Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.g., telecom, data centers, financial systems).
  • Process & governance: Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.
  • Stakeholder management: Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.
  • Team scaling & culture: Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.
  • Language: Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.
  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or executive education is a plus.

Behavioral Skills

  • Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results; drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.
  • Transparent & Courageous Communication – Communicates openly and constructively; brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.
  • Learning Agility & Adaptability – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others; adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.
  • Executive Presence with Simplicity – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.
  • Collaborative Influence – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility; leads by example.

title: Supervisor(a) Controle de Operações Agrícolas (COA)
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor de Controle de Operações Agrícolas (COA).

Quais as responsabilidades?

Supervisionar as atividades relacionadas ao abastecimento de matéria prima de todas as unidades do grupo, garantindo a execução eficiente das operações da Torre de Controle CTT e Torre de Manutenção elevando a confiabilidade dos apontamos das classes de manutenção do grupo. Coordenar a equipe de operadores, assegurando que todas as metas de desempenho das áreas sejam alcançadas, realizando o acompanhamento diário das operações e implementando melhorias contínuas nos processos.

Quais os requisitos?

Superior completo em Engenharia Agronômica ou áreas afins;

Experiência em operações CTT e Torre de Manutenção;

Sólida vivência com indicadores de performance das operações e equipamentos;

Desejável conhecimento em sistemas como Simplefarm, Gatec, Solinftec, Logtrac;

Gestão de pessoas.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Finance Planning Analyst
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Financial Planning and Budgeting

  • Support the annual budgeting process by collaborating with department heads to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and ensure alignment with corporate objectives.
  • Develop multi-scenario budget models to evaluate different business outcomes and their financial implications.
  • Consolidate data into the overall business plan, ensuring accuracy and consistency across departments.

Forecasting

  • Prepare monthly forecasts to provide management with an updated view of expected performance.
  • Continuously refine forecasting methodologies based on actual results, new market information, or changes in business conditions.
  • Collaborate with other teams to anticipate deviations and incorporate business insights into updated forecasts.

Financial Analysis and Performance Tracking

  • Perform detailed variance analyses (actual vs. budget, forecast vs. prior period) to identify key drivers of deviations in revenue, cost, and profitability.
  • Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), trends, and ratios to provide actionable insights to management.
  • Translate financial data into clear business narratives, highlighting risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Management Reporting

  • Prepare monthly management reports and executive dashboards summarizing financial performance and business trends.
  • Support the preparation of internal presentations with accurate and insightful financial data.
  • Develop automated reporting tools and dashboards to enhance transparency and reduce manual processes.

Strategic and Decision Support

  • Provide financial modeling and scenario analysis to support strategic initiatives.
  • Support ad-hoc analysis requests from management, including profitability studies and ROI evaluations.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to quantify the financial impact of operational decisions and support data-driven planning.

Cash Flow and Capital Planning

  • Monitor cash flow projections and funding requirements to ensure liquidity for ongoing operations and investments.
  • Support Treasury and Finance teams in capital allocation decisions and debt planning when required.

Process Improvement and Control

  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve FP&A processes, models, and tools to increase efficiency and accuracy.
  • Ensure data integrity and consistency between FP&A models, ERP systems, and accounting records.
  • Support internal control efforts related to financial planning, forecasting, and reporting.

Requeriments

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and Professional English, equivalent to CEFR B2 or above.
  • Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 2 - 4 years of experience in FP&A, Treasury, Controllership or related roles.
  • Strong analytical ability to manage and evaluate complex data
  • Knowledge of financial modelling
  • Experience in financial forecasting and analysis (P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow)
  • Strong communication skills to proactively interact with various business stakeholders
  • Advanced skills in the Microsoft Office Excel.
  • Excellent attention to detail, with good organizational and multitasking skills.

Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.

As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.

Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Engenheiro/a de mineração, Mina a céu aberto
description:
A G Mining Services é uma empresa multidisciplinar que oferece serviços profissionais no setor de mineração, para projetos de mineração subterrânea e a céu aberto, em metais preciosos, básicos ou industriais. Engenheiro/a de mineração, Mina a céu aberto

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Publishing Hunter is responsible for teaching and guiding new sellers to launch their first products on the SHEIN platform, ensuring they align with SHEIN’s policies and quality standards. This role plays a crucial part in the seamless transition of new sellers from onboarding to active selling status.

This role will be based in our office in São Paulo/Faria Lima. We are working 100% on-site.

Responsabilities:

  • Account and Product Verification: Lead the process of verifying new seller accounts and their product listings, ensuring compliance with SHEIN's policies and standards.
  • Publishing Guidance: Teach the new sellers about the seller’s interface on SHEIN platform, and guide them until they successfully publish the first product.
  • Quality Control: Oversee the quality control of product listings, working closely with the Quality Specialist to maintain high standards of product presentation and accuracy.
  • Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Work closely with the Hunting Support, Account Management, and Data Analytics teams to gather insights and feedback to continually improve the publishing process.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, E-Commerce, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 1 years of experience in e-commerce, product management, or a related field
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in CRM and product management software, with a strong understanding of e-commerce platforms and digital marketing principles.
  • Competencies: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a proactive approach to process improvement.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and Portuguese, with proficiency in Mandarin a plus.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: 拉美巴西区域HR负责人
description:
核心职责

1. 人力资源战略与业务伙伴：

- 深入理解拉美各重点国家（如巴西）的业务战略与挑战，提供前瞻性、可落地的人力资源规划和解方案。

- 作为业务领导团队的顾问，在组织设计、人才管理、领导力发展和变革管理等方面提供专业洞见和决策支持。

- 定期进行组织诊断，提升组织效能，确保组织架构与业务目标的高度协同。

2. 人才招聘与配置：

- 领导拉美巴西区域的全周期招聘工作，为重点和关键岗位制定高效的招聘策略。

- 建立并优化区域招聘渠道和流程，提升招聘效率和候选人体验。

- 确保人才梯队的健康构建，满足业务快速发展对各类人才的需求。

3. 绩效管理与人才发展：

- 主导实施绩效管理体系（如OKR），并确保其在本地得到有效落地和优化。

- 建立区域人才盘点机制，识别高潜人才，制定并推动关键人才的培养、发展和留任计划。

- 设计与业务目标紧密关联的培训发展体系，提升员工整体能力素质。

4. 员工关系与企业文化：

- 营造积极、包容、高绩效的企业文化，提升员工敬业度和组织凝聚力。

- 处理复杂的员工关系问题，确保公司在巴西的雇佣实践完全符合当地法律法规。

- 建立有效的内部沟通机制，确保公司价值观和战略在区域内的有效传递。

5. 薪酬福利与HR运营：

- 管理拉美巴西区域的薪酬福利体系，进行市场薪酬调研，确保薪酬策略在市场上的竞争力与内部的公平性。

- 优化HR运营流程，提升HR服务效率和员工体验。

- 管理与本地PEO（专业雇主组织）或HR外包服务商的合作（如适用）。

6. 合规与风险管理：

- 全面负责巴西的人力资源合规性，包括但不限于劳动法、税务、社保等，规避用工风险。

- 及时更新各国劳动法规政策变化，并对业务进行预警和指导。

任职要求

必备条件：

- 本科及以上学历，人力资源、管理学、心理学或相关专业。

- 10年以上人力资源领域工作经验，其中至少5年以上作为区域HR负责人或高级HRBP，全面负责巴西的人力资源管理工作。

-精通葡萄牙语优先，英语能作为工作语言。

- 对拉美巴西的劳动法、雇佣实践、社保体系和商业文化有深入理解和实操经验。

- 具备在高速增长、多变的创业环境中工作的成功经验，能够处理模糊性和复杂性。

- 出色的沟通、影响和协调能力，能够与不同文化背景的各级员工和业务领导者有效合作。

- 卓越的战略思维和解决问题的能力，能够将业务需求转化为具体的人力资源举措。

优先考虑：

- 有在(您所在的行业，如：科技、互联网、制造业等)公司的工作经验。

- 有从0到1搭建区域HR体系的经验。

- 拥有在复杂跨国公司矩阵式组织结构中工作的经验。

title: Técnico de Equipamentos Ópticos l
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. A empresa reúne a expertise complementar de dois pioneiros da indústria, um em tecnologias avançadas de lentes e outro na arte da fabricação de óculos icônicos, criando um negócio verticalmente integrado, única e exclusivamente posicionado para atender às necessidades de visão em constante evolução do mundo e à demanda global de uma indústria de óculos em crescimento. Com mais de 180.000 colaboradores em 150 países impulsionando nossas marcas icônicas, nossas pessoas são criativas, empreendedoras e reconhecidas por suas perspectivas e individualidades únicas. Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a "verem mais e serem mais" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo.

Missão:

O Técnico da EssilorLuxottica será responsável por atender clientes em todo o território nacional. Desenvolver habilidades técnicas básicas e adquirir conhecimento sobre processos, ferramentas e práticas da equipe.

Técnico responsável por instalação e manutenção com foco em atividades de baixa e média complexidade.

Também prestará suporte remoto, envolvendo monitoramento, diagnóstico e resolução de problemas técnicos, garantindo a máxima eficiência dos sistemas.

Adicionalmente, o profissional terá como objetivo apoiar as Unidades de Negócio, contribuindo para o fortalecimento das vendas e mantendo o foco na satisfação e fidelização dos clientes

Responsabilidades:

- Realizar instalação, manutenção e ajustes em equipamentos de Montagem da linha de entrada e Medição e/ou linha oftalmológica para que os equipamentos operem com máxima eficiência e precisão, garantindo a continuidade das operações dos clientes, a qualidade nos serviços prestados e a satisfação com as soluções oferecidas pela empresa.

- Documentar serviços realizados em relatórios técnicos (RAT) com clareza e detalhes nas informações para que haja rastreabilidade das intervenções, garantia de continuidade no acompanhamento técnico e suporte para tomadas de decisão estratégicas baseadas em dados precisos.

- Participar de feiras e eventos, apoiando atividades comerciais com suporte técnico para que a empresa atraia novos clientes, fortaleça parcerias e mantenha a confiabilidade nos produtos e serviços oferecidos.

- Conhecer e dominar sistemas internos e conceitos de Ótica Básica para que o técnico esteja capacitado a realizar diagnósticos rápidos, propor soluções eficazes e garantir um atendimento técnico de excelência.

- Garantir conduta profissional e comunicação adequada no atendimento a clientes para que se construa um relacionamento de confiança, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e fortalecendo a reputação da empresa no mercado.

- Conhecimento básico das linhas de montagem, medição e oftalmologia para que o técnico tenha versatilidade para atuar em diferentes demandas, proporcionando um atendimento mais completo e alinhado às necessidades dos clientes.

- Postura profissional e adequação ao dress code da empresa para que o técnico reforce a imagem de profissionalismo, alinhamento à cultura organizacional e inspire confiança durante interações com clientes e parceiros.

- Responsável por planejar e executar os atendimentos de instalação e manutenção de equipamentos seguindo a política de viagens vigente para que as operações sejam realizadas de forma eficiente, com otimização de recursos e respeito às diretrizes da empresa, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e o cumprimento dos prazos.

- Solicitar peças e componentes necessários para manutenção e reparo, orientando o cliente a devolução das mesmas quando necessário para que os reparos sejam concluídos de maneira ágil, mantendo o controle sobre os estoques e assegurando o correto funcionamento dos equipamentos.

Requisitos:

title: Analista de supply chain
description:

title: Topografo
description:

O Topógrafo de Transmissão de Alta Tensão é responsável por realizar levantamentos topográficos e georreferenciamentos de terrenos, alinhamentos e estruturas destinados à implantação de linhas de transmissão e subestações. title: Domain Architect Networking
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. We are looking for a Domain Architect Networking , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo.

In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Networking will play an essential role in the design, governance and evolution of the network architectures that support the digital, industrial and corporate operations of Brasil and Canada. He will be responsible for the strategic planning, specification, integration and optimization of corporate communication platforms: SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, OT/IT industrial networks, Wi-Fi, underground networks, data centers, cloud integration, 5G, satellite and edge for mining.

Its mission is to ensure robustness, availability, performance, security, and scalability – enabling automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, industrial IoT, and support for key critical environments. He will work directly with global IT, Operations, Security, and Engineering teams, supporting multicultural and multifunctional environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, documentation and evolution of enterprise, industrial and mission-critical network architectures for global, underground, remote, mobile/IoT and cloud/hybrid operations.
  • Specify patterns, high and low complexity diagrams (logical view, physical, topology, VLAN, routing, SDN), considering redundancy, availability, performance, and resiliency.
  • Evaluate, select and supervise deployment of emerging technologies: SD-WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, private 5G, mesh networks, VPNs, segmentation of OT/IT networks in a mining environment.
  • Define and ensure compliance with global security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), encryption policies, access control, vulnerability mitigation, and incident response.
  • Lead network integration projects between Brazil, Canada, industrial areas/mines, offices, plants and data centers, enabling high connectivity, performance and security.
  • Orchestrate processes of technological update, equipment replacement, configuration automation and network monitoring, including SRE, observability, Service Mesh.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation: diagrams, flows, contingency plans, playbooks, usage policies, governance, and technical templates.
  • Direct interface with Engineering, Operations, Security, DevOps, Industrial Automation teams, global architecture teams and strategic suppliers.
  • Monitor, optimize and evolve the communication infrastructure, aiming at maximum efficiency, IoT support, industrial analytics, autonomous mine operation and compliance.
  • Support the development of strategic projects (mining 4.0, edge computing, digital twins, cloud/industrial integration, ESG) and train internal teams.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or related.
  • Minimum of 8 years of solid experience as a network architect, working in critical industrial, enterprise/global, multinational and mining/resources environments.
  • Mastery of the main protocols, architectures and standards: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF/EIGRP, IPv6, DNS/DHCP, VLAN/VRF, MPLS, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, 5G/Edge, SASE, Zero Trust, OT/IT Convergence.
  • Real experience with Cisco (Switching, Routing, SD-WAN, SDA), Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell/Siemens industrial solutions, cloud networking platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Practical interface with complex environments: underground/mining, industrial networks, industrial environments 4.0, cloud integration, high availability, disaster recovery.
  • Experience in network automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), advanced monitoring (SNMP, NetFlow, SRE Observability).
  • Excellence in documentation, technical design, governance support, multi-platform integration and international performance with remote teams.
  • Fluent English (essential), advanced Portuguese as a differential for Brazil-Canada integration.

Soft Skills

  • Technical leadership, positive influence, consultative action and consensus building between teams and global cultures.
  • Strategic and analytical ability to plan, execute, and evolve complex, highly available architectures.
  • Clear and assertive communication with stakeholders at all levels, internationally distributed teams.
  • Proactivity, resilience, focus on solutions, adaptability and collaborative posture.
  • Absolute focus on results – operational, safety, innovation and support of infrastructure.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certificações: CCNP/CCIE, AWS/Azure/GCP Advanced Networking, CISSP, VMware NSX, ITIL Expert, TOGAF.
  • Experience in greenfield/brownfield projects, integration of industrial networks/IoT, edge/mesh/satellite, mine digitalization.
  • Experience with underground networks, mining-specific wireless solutions, industrial OT/IT environments, SRE/observability on a global scale.
  • Participation in technical forums, publications, international events, benchmarks, leadership in strategic projects from or large mining companies.
  • Ability to work in different time zones, multi-site environments and multicultural teams.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust and secure reference architecture for all Brazil and Canada network environments, including integration, automation, performance and high availability.
  • Execution of strategic projects for technological evolution, digitalization, automation, analytics and ESG, supporting business results.
  • Dissemination of best practices, technical painting of the teams involved, development of governance policies and global operation.
  • Active performance in innovation, benchmarking and implementation of new technologies that support the group's digital and operational transformation.
  • Ensuring compliance, operational resilience, risk mitigation and increasing efficiency for operations.

Additional Comments:

This professional will be a protagonist in the transformation and support of corporate, industrial and critical network architecture, enabling the global Brazil-Canada operation and the group's digital/ESG evolution.

title: Collections Lead
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As Collections lead, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy , policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You’ll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You’ll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix’s collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil’s legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

- Análise, tratamento e resposta para relatórios de ação corretiva (RAC’s) direcionados ao setor gráfico;

Cursando nível superior em Design Gráfico, Design de Produto ou Desenho Industrial. Desejável Inglês Intermediário;

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer (AWS / Terraform / Kafka) – Fintech Payments Platform

Location: Remote (UK/EU time zones)

Contract: 7 months (to April 2026)

Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS, Kafka, GitOps, Cloud-Native Tooling

Focus: Platform engineering & solution build (not ops/DevOps)

About the Role

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join a major UK retail group building a new Klarna-style fintech payments platform. This role sits at the heart of the cloud platform team and focuses on designing, building, and automating the core infrastructure that powers high-scale financial transactions.

You’ll work in a highly technical environment, collaborating with architects, backend engineers, and security teams to deliver secure, resilient, cloud-native foundations. This is a hands-on build role — not day-to-day ops or DevOps support.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Build & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable, resilient cloud platform components in AWS
  • Own Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (modular, reusable architectures)
  • Build secure multi-account AWS environments following Well-Architected principles
  • Develop internal platform tooling, automation, templates, and golden paths
  • Support EKS/Kubernetes environments and microservice deployment foundations

Event-Driven & Distributed Architecture

  • Build and support Kafka-based event streaming and messaging capabilities
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and idempotent service patterns
  • Work with engineers to define infrastructure for distributed, real-time systems

Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and distributed tracing (Datadog/Grafana/ELK)
  • Ensure SLAs/SLOs for platform components are met
  • Contribute to disaster recovery design, multi-region readiness, and resilience testing

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Enforce best practices for IAM, secrets management, encryption, and network security
  • Build guardrails, policies, and automated compliance into CI/CD and IaC workflows
  • Contribute to platform risk assessments and mitigation strategies

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with architects, platform leads, and product teams to translate requirements into technical designs
  • Work with developers to guide best practices for cloud-native builds
  • Mentor engineers in IaC, automation, and platform engineering patterns

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong experience with AWS (multi-account, networking, security, core services)
  • Excellent Terraform skills, building modular and production-grade IaC
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes / EKS or similar orchestration platforms
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies
  • Hands-on with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)
  • Strong understanding of monitoring, distributed tracing, and observability
  • Ability to work autonomously in fast-paced, cloud-native engineering teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or high-throughput distributed systems
  • Knowledge of Well-Architected Framework, security engineering, compliance
  • Familiarity with service mesh, API gateways, or serverless components
  • Exposure to Python/Go/TypeScript for automation or tooling

What This Role is Not

  • Not day-to-day ops or support
  • Not traditional DevOps or SRE maintenance
  • Not basic provisioning or infra monitoring
  • Not a junior cloud role

This is a platform build position: architecture + IaC + automation + infrastructure foundations.

title: Técnico em Mecânica
description:
Principais atividades :

  • Planejar e executar as manutenções de motores, bombas, conjuntos hidráulicos, compressores, geradores de vapor no campo e em bancada;
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar defeitos das disciplinas voltadas a mecânica pneumática, hidráulica dos equipamentos mecânicos da fábrica;
  • Elaborar relatórios, descrevendo os problemas detectados, suas causas básicas e como devem ser direcionados;
  • Elaborar RFCA através de relatórios; investigar e analisar falhas a fim de determinar a causa raiz dos problemas relacionados à manutenção ou desenho;
  • Controlar o almoxarifado, garantindo rotatividade das peças, eficácia na armazenagem, controle e disponibilidade;
  • Controlar o empréstimo de ferramentas garantindo conservação e disponibilidade;
  • Executar manutenções preventivas e corretivas a fim de garantir os índices de manutenção saudáveis e eficientes, gerando mais disponibilidade para a fábrica;
  • Montar e fazer manutenção em tubulações, bombas e motores; Cumprir com os treinamentos aplicáveis ao cargo;
  • Checar diariamente as ordens de manutenção disponíveis no CMMS;
  • Contatar fornecedores para garantir spare parts críticos da manutenção, baseando-se no prazo de entrega e fabricação do equipamento.

Requisitos obrigatórios :

  • Técnico em Mecânica, Técnico em Manutenção Industrial e/ou áreas correlatas.

Desejável :

  • Conhecimento em análise de vibração, lubrificação, leitura e interpretação de P&ID;
  • Conhecimento em integridade mecânica, NR-13, conhecimento em bombas de deslocamento positivos: helicoidais, engrenagem, lóbulo, bombas centrifugas;
  • Conhecimento em Excel, Autocad.

Local da Vaga: Salto/SP

Sobre a Stepan:

Fundada em 1932, a Stepan Company é uma importante fabricante de produtos químicos básicos e intermediários, incluindo surfactantes, polímeros, bem como ingredientes especiais que entram em produtos de consumo, domésticos e institucionais, como detergentes para roupas, xampus e limpadores de superfícies. A Stepan Company possui atualmente 20 fábricas globais e mais de 2.000 funcionários. Temos um forte histórico de crescimento. Nosso crescimento nos permite oferecer oportunidades de carreira significativas e estabilidade aos membros de nossa equipe. Temos grandes objetivos na Stepan e sabemos que cada membro da equipe será crucial para alcançar nossos objetivos. Independentemente da função, procuramos membros da equipe que tragam consigo uma mentalidade de crescimento, um espírito empreendedor e a capacidade de prosperar em um ambiente em evolução.

Celebramos a diversidade na Stepan e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente diversificado e inclusivo. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador de oportunidades iguais. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para o emprego independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, gênero, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, informações genéticas, deficiência, idade, status de veterano ou qualquer outro status protegido pela lei aplicável.
